title: Upcoming EU Compliance Exam: ChatGPT and Roblox Face the Stricter Platform Regulation

content_html:
With both the monthly active users in the European Union surpassing 45 million, OpenAI's ChatGPT and the well-known interactive entertainment platform Roblox will be officially subject to the EU Digital Services Act (DSA). This means that the two platforms will have to follow the highest compliance framework set by the EU for super-large digital platforms.

According to the current progress plan of the European Commission, these two products could be formally designated as Very Large Online Platforms (VLOPs as early as August this year. After this designation, the platforms will not only need to continuously upgrade their content moderation mechanisms, transparency reports, and risk prevention measures, but they will also face more stringent and routine compliance monitoring and reviews by EU regulatory authorities.

content_html_zh:
随着欧盟月活跃用户超过4500万，OpenAI的ChatGPT和知名互动娱乐平台Roblox将正式受到欧盟数字服务法案（DSA）的约束。 这意味着这两个平台将必须遵循欧盟为超大型数字平台制定的最高合规框架。

根据欧盟委员会目前的进展计划，这两款产品最早可能在今年8月被正式指定为超大型在线平台（VLOPs）。 此次指定后，平台不仅需要不断升级内容审核机制、透明度报告和风险防范措施，还将面临欧盟监管机构更加严格、日常的合规监控和审查。
